name: Shinozaki Hiyu
source: A female student who admires the “Battle Princess” Erika Ikusa. She is extremely fond of beautiful girls, to the point that she calls herself a “Walking Database of Girls,” and tends to get a nosebleed from the excitement of seeing a super cute girl. She calls her classmate Erika “Sister,” and becomes her “knight” to support her school life on the girls side.
